summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Memory Match Kids game. All core functionality working perfectly including start screen, game mechanics, level progression, timer, reset, and responsive design. Game successfully progresses from Level 1 (4 cards) to Level 2 (6 cards) with proper card matching logic and shuffling.
passed_tests: Start screen displays with title, 'How to Play' section, and START button
START button initiates game and shows Level 1 with 4 cards (2 pairs)
Timer starts counting when game begins and displays in MM:SS format
Card flip animation works when clicking cards
Matching cards logic works correctly - matched pairs stay flipped
Level progression works - Level 1 (4 cards) progresses to Level 2 (6 cards)
SVG images load correctly from /cards/ directory
Reset button works and returns to start screen
Cards are randomly shuffled each time game starts
Responsive design works on mobile (390x844), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1920x1080)
Timer displays correctly in MM:SS format and counts properly
All UI elements are clickable and properly integrated
Game board adapts to different screen sizes with appropriate grid layouts
